versions.content: Starting the secure coding sequence Upon receiving a cer- tificate via the UDS service transmitCertificate with a certificateEvaluationId mapped to a DcmDspAuthenticationTransmitCertificate with DcmDspAuthentica- tionTransmitCertificateFunction that is set to = SECURE_CODING, the Dcm shall (re-)start the secure coding mechanism and use this certificate to validate the secure coding data.
